name: Testsigma
description_en:
Testsigma provides a managed test-automation platform for web, mobile, API and other supported application workflows, with AI-assisted authoring and maintenance. Its documentation separates cloud execution from testing through an operator-installed local Agent. Marketing confidence scores are not independent release approval.

This profile evaluates a proposed controlled test plan, the local execution route, locator healing and failure diagnosis. It keeps plan-level deployment/fee conditions and upcoming features explicit. No account, Agent, device, app, test, locator approval, schedule, notification or purchase was operated.
description_zh:
Testsigma 为网页、移动、API 及其他受支持应用提供托管测试自动化，含 AI 辅助编写及维护。文档区分云执行与运维安装本地 Agent 的测试。营销信心分数不是独立发布批准。

本文评估受控测试计划、本地执行路径、定位修复及失败诊断，明确套餐部署／费用条件及待推出功能。本次未操作账户、Agent、设备、应用、测试、定位批准、调度、通知或购买。

sections.title_en: Managed cloud does not eliminate local target requirements
sections.title_zh: 托管云不消除本地目标要求
sections.en: The Cloud introduction describes managed infrastructure, while Agent documentation covers the separate route to machines and devices in the operator’s network. Select where the application and browser/device actually run. A cloud account alone does not make a private target reachable or establish local device compatibility. Check the selected test lab, host prerequisites and account entitlement before creating a plan.
sections.zh: Cloud 介绍托管设施，Agent 文档则说明运维网络内机器／设备的独立路径。需选择应用和浏览器／设备实际运行位置。只有云账户不令私有目标自动可达，也不证明本地设备兼容。创建计划前应核所选测试环境、主机前提及账户权益。

sections.title_en: The local Agent still exchanges test data with the server
sections.title_zh: 本地 Agent 仍与服务器交换测试数据
sections.en: The Java Agent bundles runtime and browser/mobile utilities and requests instructions through a pull model over secured communication. The FAQ says it does not accept unsolicited incoming server connections; outbound connectivity is still needed. Mobile inspection sends app element details through the browser for saving on Testsigma servers. Evaluate host access and captured data deliberately rather than treating local execution as entirely offline or data-local. No Agent was installed.
sections.zh: Java Agent 包含运行时及浏览器／移动工具，通过安全通信拉取指令。FAQ 称不接受服务器主动传入连接，但仍需出站连接；移动检查会将元素细节经浏览器发送并保存至 Testsigma 服务器。需主动评估主机访问及捕获数据，不能将本地执行当作完全离线或数据仅本地。本次未安装 Agent。

sections.title_en: A pending heal is not yet the primary locator
sections.title_zh: 待定修复还不是主要定位
sections.en: The insights guide says a replacement can continue the run and remain pending for future attempts. Primary changes require Approve as Primary and an update after inspecting linked test cases. The selected element may be shared, so approval can affect multiple cases. Compare the old/new locator and actual screenshot before accepting a replacement; if it is wrong, correct or relearn the step instead of interpreting a healed status as automatic correctness.
sections.zh: 洞察指南称替代定位可继续运行，并保持待定供后续尝试；改为主要定位需 Approve as Primary，并检查关联用例后更新。元素可共享，批准可能影响多个用例。接受前应比较旧／新定位及截图，错误时应手动纠正或重新捕获，不能把 Healed 状态当作自动正确。

sections.title_en: Plan type and machine settings affect later edits
sections.title_zh: 计划类型及机器设置影响后续编辑
sections.en: A plan binds suites to test-machine profiles, environment, timeouts and screenshot choices. The guide distinguishes cross-browser from custom plans and says type cannot be switched once test machines are configured. Deleting a plan removes associated schedules, run reports and configuration. For a proposed evaluation, use a disposable plan with synthetic data, capture its settings and preserve needed results before any deletion. No plan was changed.
sections.zh: 计划将套件绑定到测试机器、环境、超时及截图选项。指南区分跨浏览器与自定义计划，配置机器后不能切换类型。删除计划会移除关联调度、运行报告及配置。拟评估宜用虚构数据的可丢弃计划、记录设置，并在任何删除前保留所需结果。本次未改计划。

sections.title_en: The reported failing step may have an earlier cause
sections.title_zh: 报错步骤的原因可能在更早处
sections.en: The debugging guide distinguishes an element error from an earlier flow divergence or unfinished prerequisite. Inspect earlier screenshots and the expected baseline before changing the locator. Analyzer verdicts give suggestions, but not every fix is automatically applicable. Network logs also require capture enabled and completed upload; an empty panel is not proof that no requests occurred. Downstream not-executed steps should remain separate from passed results.
sections.zh: 调试指南区分元素错误与更早的流程偏离／前提未完成。修改定位前需检查较早截图及预期基线。Analyzer 给建议，但不是每项都能自动应用。网络日志需启用捕获并完成上传，空面板不证明没有请求。下游未执行步骤应与通过结果分开。

sections.title_en: Healing a test is not restoring application state
sections.title_zh: 修复测试不是恢复应用状态
sections.en: Locator maintenance addresses how a test finds an element; plan recovery actions and post-plan hooks configure other behavior. They do not establish that a failed write flow is transactionally undone. Define test fixtures, expected side effects and cleanup for the actual application. Review repeated runs against the same data before trusting the result, and retain the first failure’s context rather than replacing it with an eventual pass.
sections.zh: 定位维护解决测试如何找到元素，计划恢复动作和后置 hook 配置其他行为，不证明失败写入流程已按事务撤销。需按真实应用定义样本、副作用及清理。信任结果前应审重复运行对同一数据的影响，并保留首次失败上下文，而非只留最终通过。

sections.title_en: Quoted plans still have explicit capacity and roadmap scope
sections.title_zh: 询价方案仍有明确容量及路线图范围
sections.en: The public page uses custom quotes for Pro and Enterprise. Unlimited automated minutes coexist with parallel-execution capacity and a listed 50 GB cloud-storage allowance per parallel. Enterprise adds separately described deployment, network and identity controls; Autonomous Testing is labeled Upcoming. Confirm the target product, parallel count and actual AI feature availability in the quote. No public numeric total, unlimited concurrency or sustained-free Cloud entitlement is inferred.
sections.zh: 公开页为 Pro、Enterprise 定制询价。无限自动分钟与并发容量及每并发 50 GB 云存储额度并存。Enterprise 另述部署、网络及身份控制，Autonomous Testing 标 Upcoming。询价需核目标产品、并发数及真实 AI 可用性。未推定公开总金额、无限并发或持续免费 Cloud 权益。
